data.name: Carbono Capital
data.description: Carbono Capital SpA is a Chile-based biochar producer that uses off-grid kilns to pyrolyze waste biomass into biochar, which is blended with compost and applied to family-owned agricultural land. The project is listed on the Isometric registry, with the first kiln unit launching in 2025 and five more planned for 2026, targeting ~3,110 tonnes of biochar and up to ~8,806 removal credits annually.
